en.title: US child passport: renew or apply again?

items.text: Apply again in person, both parents
A parent signs a statement or attends

cards.heading: Last passport issued at 16 or over

en.alt: Diagram comparing US passports by age. Under 16: valid for five years, cannot be renewed, apply again in person with both parents. At 16 or 17: valid for ten years; a passport issued before 16 means applying again, and a parent signs a statement or attends. If the last passport was issued at 16 or over, renewal may be possible
en.caption: Sixteen is the line: before it, every new passport starts from scratch.
